criteria.description: The game starts normally and enters a controllable playing state.
Desktop steering changes the craft trajectory on both axes with readable camera response.
Relay restoration leads to an extraction objective with observable victory behavior, or the terminal path is otherwise directly evidenced.
The ordered relay objective is understandable and appears to be a real gameplay progression system.
Charge, hazards, collisions, or course boundaries create observable gameplay pressure rather than decoration only.
The 3D route, craft, objective, hazards, HUD, and motion feedback are visually readable during play.
Pause or restart works and returns the game to a valid state without obvious corruption.
At 390 x 844 the game remains readable and exposes pointer or touch steering sufficient to interact with the course without incoherent overlap.
